'''Graham''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he and Moff [[Dolus]] were invited by a fellow Moff [[Valion Pyron]] to observe the testing of the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Doombringer]]''. When Pyron introduces Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] as the one responsible for the completion of the Silencer, Graham voiced his annoyance of [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Thanaton]]. Before the testing, Captain [[Joris]] of [[Darth Achelon]]'s flagship ''[[Carnage]]'' requested aid and Graham suggested to destroy Achelon. After the successful testing of the Silencer, Graham agreed to support Kallig.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moff Graham appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission.
